from solution import median_trapezium


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: median_trapezium(15,25,35)==20."""
    # (15+25)/2 = 40/2 = 20
    assert median_trapezium(15, 25, 35) == 20


def test_issue_equal_bases():
    """Median is average of bases: equal bases give that base."""
    # (10+10)/2 = 20/2 = 10
    assert median_trapezium(10, 10, 5) == 10


def test_issue_swapped_bases():
    """Median is average of bases: order of bases does not matter."""
    # (25+15)/2 = 40/2 = 20
    assert median_trapezium(25, 15, 35) == 20


def test_issue_height_does_not_change_median():
    """Median is average of bases: height does not change result."""
    # (15+25)/2 = 40/2 = 20
    assert median_trapezium(15, 25, 5) == 20


def test_issue_zero_base():
    """Median is average of bases: zero base gives half the other base."""
    # (0+20)/2 = 20/2 = 10
    assert median_trapezium(0, 20, 10) == 10


def test_issue_odd_sum_gives_half():
    """Median is average of bases: odd sum gives .5 value."""
    # (10+15)/2 = 25/2 = 12.5
    assert median_trapezium(10, 15, 6) == 12.5


def test_issue_fractional_bases():
    """Median is average of bases: fractional bases average exactly."""
    # (7.5+12.5)/2 = 20/2 = 10
    assert median_trapezium(7.5, 12.5, 4) == 10


def test_issue_large_bases():
    """Median is average of bases: large values average correctly."""
    # (1000+2000)/2 = 3000/2 = 1500
    assert median_trapezium(1000, 2000, 500) == 1500


def test_contract_keyword_arguments():
    """Public interface: median_trapezium(base1, base2, height) supports keywords."""
    # (6+14)/2 = 20/2 = 10
    assert median_trapezium(base1=6, base2=14, height=3) == 10


def test_contract_callable():
    """Public interface: solution.median_trapezium is callable."""
    assert callable(median_trapezium)
